text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~~♪ Al~waaaays~~♪ singing wonderful~ 
so~ongs~~♪ Take it away!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
An angelic duet spun just for me...! What 
a truly delightful gift!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ I'm glad we practiced, Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I was embarrassed to death...\nBut... if 
it made them this happy—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
O angels...! If it is not too much to ask, 
would you let me hear your singing voices 
once more?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I shall join in on the 
accompaniment! Come, let us have a session 
together!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, absolutely!\nCheval-chan, let's do 
it together on three!\nOne, two, three—"
